The exact 5:87 and 5:96 HFT trace supplies all four nominated coordinates and a changed reading from temporary restriction to a calibrated boundary. The two unresolved context branches are retained as attributed evidence, not completed lexically.

The exact 5:95-5:96 trace supplies the compensation, likeness, measure, sanctuary gift, feeding, undergoing, food, livelihood, and useful-provision contacts. The unresolved branches remain attributed and the supplied focus branches preserve their exact core facets.

findings.title: Sea and land are a calibrated legal pair
findings.claim: 5:96 makes the sea catch and its food available as useful provision for the addressed people and travelers, while land catch is withheld for the duration of the sacred state.
findings.mechanism: The two صَيْد occurrences are carried by the paired بَحْر and بَرّ domains; أُحِلَّ and حُرِّمَ place opposite rulings over those domains, مَتَاعًا and the traveler phrase give the permission a practical beneficiary, and the duration phrase binds the land restriction to the embodied حُرُمًا state. The following sacred-place and sacred-time context makes the boundary institutional rather than arbitrary.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see a rule that sorts access by domain and state: the permission supplies mobile use, but sacred status still marks a real stopping point.
findings.containment: This retains the ordinary sea-food permission and time-bound land prohibition. It does not turn every sea/land contrast into a moral allegory or infer a general ban on travel, food, or all land use.

epistemic.reason: The focus carriers and the trusted channel nomination are exact, while the macro relation and the qualified protected-place branch require bounded interpretation.

findings.mechanism: The focus passive release and prohibition carriers meet 5:87's good-things and overstepping occurrences. findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the paired rulings as a measured legal posture between needless deprivation and careless taking.
findings.containment: The ordinary sea/land rule remains intact. The two 5:87 context branches are legacy-unbound HFT roles and are retained only as attributed contextual evidence; no independent gloss is invented for them.
